title: fix: keep api keys out of the public image feed
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Added feedImageURL() to omit credential-like query parameters from public image-feed imageURL events while preserving the order and encoding of other parameters. Image generation, caching, and response headers are unchanged.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden studio, Polli wears a tiny librarian scarf and tends a vine of picture frames beside a retro monitor showing an image feed; a small sealed-key icon rests safely away from the frames. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, with consistent rounded proportions, strictly pixel art. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green (#ecf874), warm cream, and dark purple (#110518) accents.
